Definition: Integration with national payment systems for government-to-person (G2P), government-to-business (G2B) transactions via data exchange
Comments: PayLogic was awarded (Jan 2025) a project to implement an interoperable digital payment switch under PADSF. An interoperable payment system for financial institutions is under development but not yet operational. E-wallet 'Mbango' launched 2023 by Comores en Ligne. The AfDB project also includes a digital public payment system component.

Definition: Whether primary laws, acts, or legal instruments exist that establish authority for cross-government data sharing and govern the data exchange system
Comments: Personal Data Protection Law (2021, enacted June 29, 2021) and Cybersecurity Law (Law 21-012, 2022) exist. No specific cross-government data sharing legislation found. The AfDB project plans to create the National Authority for Protection of Personal Data. No dedicated interoperability or data exchange law documented.

Definition: Extent to which the data exchange enables services accessible to all population groups including persons with disabilities, elderly, low literacy
Comments: Internet penetration was 27.3% in 2024. Household internet access at 5.56%. Mobile affordability index is 21.78 (very low). Digital services are very limited in accessibility for disabled or low-literacy populations. No accessibility standards for e-government documented.

Definition: Provisions ensuring national control over government data and protecting against unauthorized foreign access
Comments: Personal Data Protection Law enacted June 29, 2021 (Law on Protection of Personal Data) establishes data protection framework. A National Authority for Personal Data Protection is created by the law but not yet operational as of mid-2024. Data localization planned via the new Tier-III data centre (operational May 2025). Controls are in legislation but enforcement body not yet constituted.

Comments: Significant urban-rural divide. Key challenge identified by ANADEN and international partners. Rural areas have very limited digital access.
